title: Advanced energy harvesting from low-frequency ocean waves for lithium-ion battery applications
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01492A, Paper
Yingjin Luo, Wentao Lei, Pengfei Chen, Tao Jiang, Andeng Liu, Meidan Ye, Zijie Xu, Zhong Lin Wang, Wenxi Guo
A universal energy storage strategy is designed for TENGs in real marine environments, where IRMS reached 0.86 ± 0.02 A m−2 Hz−1, enabling the direct charging of 30 and 40 mA h lithium batteries in 2.33 ± 0.05 and 3.73 ± 0.14 h, respectively.
